Skillet Chili

Serves: 4
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 onion, chopped
* 2 cloves garlic
• 1 can diced tomatoes
- 1 tbsp chili powder

Directions:
1. Brown the beef with the
onion and garlic.
2. Stir in the tomatoes and chili powder.

Simmer until thickened.
